data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 25/2338Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: NOAA AIRCRAFT MEASURES CATEGORY 5 WINDS IN POLO. ...INTERESTS IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR SHOULD MONITOR ITS PROGRESS... As of 2:00 PM MST Fri Sep 25 the center of Polo was located near 17.2, -109.2 with movement W at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 913 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 180 mph.
